# Pragmatic @ Stage 1 — Prehension

> developed 2026-07-25.

## Expression on this line

Pragmatic intelligence at Stage 1 is **pre-agency functional differentiation**. There is no problem-solver, no goal, and no error correction yet; there is only the bare physical fact that a system responds differently to different structural conditions. A crystal lattice forms differently under different temperature gradients; a chemical substrate reacts differently under different catalytic constraints. This is the **physical floor of practicality**: before anything can “solve” anything, reality must already support distinguishable functional configurations.

The capacity here is extremely narrow but foundational: **reliable differential response**. The limitation is equally absolute: no memory beyond physical trace, no selection, no repair, no representation of a problem-state. Pragmatic Stage 1 is not primitive problem-solving; it is the **pre-practical precondition** for problem-solving: a world in which functional differences can make a difference at all.

## Integrity markers (healthy inclusion)

- **UL (interior-individual):** no interior practical correlate; no desire, intention, or problem representation.
- **UR (exterior-individual):** reliable state-transition differences under different physical constraints.
- **LL (interior-collective):** none; no shared practical meaning, norm, or technique.
- **LR (exterior-collective):** physical boundary conditions, material gradients, and structural constraints as the only “environment” of functional differentiation.

## Pathology markers (Agape / Eros)

- **Dark addiction (clinging to this stage):** structural fixation — the system locks into one differential response pattern and cannot register novel constraint differences.
- **Dark allergy (skipping this stage):** indiscriminate response — no stable functional differentiation, so later practical learning has no reliable physical substrate.
- **Golden addiction (grasping higher prematurely):** anthropomorphic projection — treating mere physical reactivity as intentional problem-solving.
- **Golden allergy (refusing higher emergence):** denial of the physical floor — refusing to recognize functional differentiation as the legitimate base of the pragmatic line.

## Diagnostic cues (universal signal-types)

Falsifiable signals that a system’s CoG on this line is at **Stage 1**:

- **Differential state-transition probability:** the system produces different physical outcomes under different constraint classes.
- **No feedback-based correction:** outcome differences do not modify future response selection.
- **No persistent functional selection:** any “successful” configuration persists only as physical relaxation, not as retained method.

## Sources, joints, open questions

- **Sources:** Charles S. Peirce, *Collected Papers* — the pragmatic maxim as a floor for evaluating functional consequences; John Dewey, *Logic: The Theory of Inquiry* — inquiry emerging from indeterminate situations; Ilya Prigogine & Isabelle Stengers, *Order Out of Chaos* — physical self-organization as pre-biological functional differentiation.
- **Open joints:** at what point does physical functional differentiation become biological regulation?
- **Research debt:** pairs with Stage 2 `irritability` and the physical/biological boundary in the cognitive line.
